report.title: The nested checklist cannot display levels correctly
report.body: ### Pre-submission Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet - [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version ### Where did you encounter this bug? Latest stable version (self-hosted) ### Memos Version v0.26.0 ### Bug Description The nested checklist cannot display levels correctly; all items appear on the same level. Furthermore, clicking the checkbox of a sub-checklist incorrectly marks the item above it. The syntax for nested checklists was correctly supported in previous versions. ### Steps to Reproduce The testing markdown is ```markdown - [ ] task1 - [ ] task1.1 - [ ] task 1.1.1 - [ ] task1.2 - [ ] task2 ``` ### Expected Behavior _No response_ ### Screenshots & Additional Context _No response_

steps: Open the memo editor on the home page to create a new memo
Type the line '- [ ] task1' and press Enter
Type the line ' - [ ] task1.1' (indented by 4 spaces) and press Enter
Type the line ' - [ ] task 1.1.1' (indented by 8 spaces) and press Enter
Type the line ' - [ ] task1.2 ' (indented by 4 spaces) and press Enter
Type the line '- [ ] task2' with no indentation
Click the Save button to publish the memo
View the rendered memo in the memo list
Click the checkbox of 'task1.1' in the rendered memo
plan.expected: the rendered memo shows task1.1 and task1.2 indented under task1, task 1.1.1 indented under task1.1, and clicking the checkbox of task1.1 checks only task1.1
plan.reported_actual: All checklist items render at the same level with no nesting, and clicking the checkbox of a sub-item marks the item above it instead.
missing: assumed: the expected behavior is that nested levels render indented and each checkbox toggles only its own item, since the reporter left it blank
assumed: the indentation in the markdown is 4 spaces per level
assumed: the editor may auto-indent or auto-continue list items on Enter, so the exact typed text may differ from the sample markdown
Which item was incorrectly marked when a sub-item checkbox was clicked (the screenshot is not available)?
Does the issue occur in the editor preview or only in the saved memo view?
plan.summary: Nested checklist items render at one level and clicking a sub-item checkbox toggles the item above
